# Test fixtures

- `sample_stream.jsonl` — a **hand-written** event stream for an R002-style real-signal air-leak
  incident, used by the frontend before the live API exists and by contract tests. Values are
  illustrative, not the output of a real run. The manual quotes are placeholders until
  `simulator/manuals/compressed_air.md` exists; replace them with verbatim quotes then (the verifier
  rule requires it).
